LIST.EMPTY: No bank or cash accounts to show.

TRANSACTIONS.TITLE: Transactions
TRANSACTIONS.EMPTY: No transactions to show for this account.

RECONCILIATIONS.INITIATE_DISABLED_HINT: Finish or wait out the current reconciliation period before starting a new one.
RECONCILIATIONS.DELETE_MESSAGE: This removes the period and unlinks its transactions. This can't be undone.

FORM.EMPTY: No transactions match the current filter.
FORM.CONFIRM_SAVE_MESSAGE: The selected transactions will be marked as reconciled for this period.

FILE_RECONCILIATION.TITLE: File Reconciliation
FILE_RECONCILIATION.SUBTITLE: Compare an uploaded bank-statement file against this account's own transactions and find matching, unmatched, and mismatched records. Matching runs in your browser and nothing is saved — your transactions are fetched live, the statement file isn't uploaded anywhere.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.OUR_TRANSACTIONS_SUMMARY: {{count}} transactions loaded for the selected date range
FILE_RECONCILIATION.NO_TRANSACTIONS_FOR_RANGE: No transactions found for this date range.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.ERROR_LOAD_TRANSACTIONS: Couldn't load this account's transactions. Please try again.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.MODAL_SUBTITLE: Match a bank statement against this sheet's transactions.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.DROP_TITLE: Choose or drop a bank statement
FILE_RECONCILIATION.DROP_HINT: CSV or Excel. Each line needs a date and an amount; a reference number makes matching more accurate.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.NOTE_DIRECTION: Money in is matched only with money in, and money out with money out.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.WARN_REFERENCE_EMPTY: The reference column is empty in almost every line, so reference matching cannot find anything. Pick another column, or use Amount + Date.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.SKIPPED_ROWS: {{count}} blank or total lines in the file were skipped.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.HINT_NOT_IN_BOOKS: These statement lines have no entry in the books yet, for example bank charges or interest. Record them, then reconcile again.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.HINT_OUTSTANDING: These entries are in the books but not on the statement. They are usually outstanding items, such as cheques or deposits that have not cleared yet.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.PICK_COLUMNS: Choose the date and amount columns (or a reference column) to see the matches.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.EMPTY_MATCHED: No matching records found with the current settings.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.EMPTY_UNMATCHED: No unmatched records — everything lined up.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.ERROR_EMPTY_FILE: No columns were found in that file.
FILE_RECONCILIATION.ERROR_PARSE_FAILED: Couldn't read that file. Please check it's a valid CSV or Excel file.
